dedupe_keys.name: digital dividend insights for spectrum decisions itu 2018

description: This ITU report helps national spectrum decision makers allocate the digital dividend, the spectrum freed in broadcasting bands when analogue television moves to digital terrestrial television and as broadcasting technology becomes more efficient. Its contents include the definition, potential usage, availability, size and importance of the digital dividend, set in the wider roadmap of ITU guidelines for the analogue to digital transition, which has 43 functional building blocks, one of them on the digital dividend. The foreword is signed by the directors of the Telecommunication Development Bureau and the Radiocommunication Bureau. Producer: ITU, Geneva, 2018, 84 pages. Coverage: global, with country experience examples. Access: free PDF on the ITU-D site; the foreword and contents were read, the remaining chapters were not. Licence and cost: free to download; the report states all rights reserved. Caveats: it is a policy guide, not a dataset, and figures on dividend size come from the report's own methods. Simulation uses: the size and usage estimates support capacity-planning scenarios for freed broadcast spectrum and the effect of switch-off on coverage. Related record: WorldDAB country status for digital radio (data-worlddab-country-status-digital-radio).
